findings.title: Direct logging of PII (full_name and email)
findings.evidence:
logger.info(
    "sync: progress recorded for %s (%s) lesson=%s score=%s",
    student.full_name,
    student.email,
    record.lesson_id,
    record.score,
)
findings.explanation: The new logging statement writes student.full_name and student.email directly to logs. TEAM-STANDARDS.md §3 forbids writing PII (and especially pii-minor) to logs; logs must use app.privacy.redact() to avoid direct or indirect exposure. Even though another log line uses redact() for student_id and lesson_id, this new statement bypasses redaction and will expose personal data (and for minors this is an S1 violation because minors' data must not be logged or leave the service).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the name and email from logs, or redact the payload before logging. For example, log only non-PII identifiers (student.id) or call app.privacy.redact() on a dict and log that. If logging is required for support/analytics, ensure data minimization and document a legal basis and retention policy in the PR; do not log pii-minor at all without explicit documented justification.

summary: One S1 finding: added logger.info writes student.full_name and student.email to logs, violating TEAM-STANDARDS.md §3 (PII logging).
